Dear [Authorized OEM Partner],

The Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (PGCIL) invites your esteemed organization to submit a formal quotation for the supply of control panels as outlined in the tender reference **GEM/2026/B/TEST_BROKEN**. This RFQ is issued under the authority of **PGCIL** and pertains to the project titled **“Procurement of Control Panels.”**  

---

### 1. Scope of Work  
Supply, test, and deliver the control panels in accordance with the technical specifications and delivery requirements detailed below.

### 2. Itemized Bill of Quantities (BoQ) & Requirements  

| No. | Item Description | Quantity | Unit | Technical Specification | Delivery Location | Required By Date |
|-----|------------------|----------|------|--------------------------|-------------------|------------------|

*Please note that the fields marked with **[NEEDS REVIEW: …]** are placeholders pending final confirmation. Kindly retain these exact strings in your response.*

### 3. Information Required in Your Quotation  

1. **Unit Price** (exclusive of GST) for each line item.  
2. **Lead Time** – expressed in weeks or days from receipt of purchase order.  
3. **GST Breakdown** – applicable GST rate, amount, and total cost inclusive of GST.  
4. **Technical Compliance Sheet** – a signed declaration confirming conformity with the stated technical specifications, applicable standards, and any certifications.  

### 4. Commercial & Delivery Constraints  

No additional commercial or delivery constraints have been stipulated beyond the items listed above.  

### 5. Submission Instructions  

- Submit your quotation in PDF format to **procurement@pgcil.co.in** no later than **[insert submission deadline]**.  
- The quotation must be signed by an authorized signatory of your organization.  
- Include the tender reference **GEM/2026/B/TEST_BROKEN** in the subject line of the email.  

### 6. Contact for Clarifications  

For any technical or commercial queries, please contact:  

- **Name:** [Your Name]  
- **Title:** Procurement & Supply Chain Specialist, Volks Energie  
- **Phone:** [Your Phone Number]
